name: Tooki Roka
source: Kuzuha's 'successor' as the manifestation of the legends of the nine-tailed fox. She is still immature, with the mind of a young child.  She is sweet-natured and loving, easily becoming attached to Shiina and Takuto on their first meeting. As the cause of Takuto and Shiina being drawn into the land of the gods, she feels an intense sense of responsibility.
